## Current Role

Sr. Software Engineer, Pipelining at Softline Solutions (https://www.softlinesolutions.com), Sep 2026 – Present.
Agency Services, Data group. Los Angeles, CA.

Building the GCP-based data platform behind a performance marketing agency running paid search, paid social, programmatic, SEO, and e-commerce across 1,500+ client accounts.

Key work:
- Ingestion pipelines on Google Cloud: Pub/Sub → Cloud Functions → BigQuery, 15+ platform connectors (Google Ads, GA4, Meta, Microsoft Advertising, Amazon Ads), 3+ GB/day
- High-load backend services in Kotlin and Java (Spring Boot, Ktor) — async processing, backpressure, idempotent writes, multi-tenant workloads
- Connector framework for third-party marketing APIs: incremental sync, rate-limit management, schema evolution, dead-letter recovery, failure isolation
- Optimized pipeline execution: cut end-to-end run time by 63%
- BigQuery warehouse modeling: partitioned/clustered tables, star-schema, materialized views — reduced query time by 77%
- Data quality: freshness SLAs, anomaly detection, 99.6% reconciliation accuracy
- Observability: Cloud Monitoring, structured logging, per-connector error budgets
- Security: least-privilege IAM, secret management, audited dataset access

## Open-Source Projects

### TraceShrink
- URL: https://github.com/TimurRakhmatullin86/traceshrink
- Language: Go
- Description: Cost-aware OpenTelemetry Collector processor. Keeps expensive traces, drops cheap ones — saving up to 98% storage costs. Includes cost annotation processor that prices LLM spans using embedded pricing data for 2,764 models.
- Performance: 1.84M spans/sec throughput
- Tests: 24

### PromptFirewall
- URL: https://github.com/TimurRakhmatullin86/promptfirewall
- Language: Rust, Python (PyO3), Node.js (napi-rs)
- Description: Multi-layer prompt injection detection library. Rule-based scanning — no ML model required. Ships with middleware for FastAPI and Express.
- Performance: 11.9μs per scan
- Tests: 149
- Packages: crates.io, PyPI, npm

### LogCompress
- URL: https://github.com/TimurRakhmatullin86/logcompress
- Language: Rust
- Description: Semantic log compression for incident investigation. Trace-aware expansion pulls all related log lines by trace ID. Parallel tokenization via Rayon.
- Performance: 100% recall on benchmark (55/55 queries, 5 incident types)
- Tests: 34
- Packages: crates.io

### CodeShrink
- URL: https://github.com/TimurRakhmatullin86/codeshrink
- Language: Rust, Node.js (napi-rs)
- Description: Code-aware context compressor for LLMs. Extracts function signatures while discarding implementation details. Helps fit entire repositories into LLM context windows.
- Performance: 99.9% compression (1.29M LOC → 1.5K in 2.8s)
- Tests: 16
- Packages: crates.io, npm

### MCP-Drill
- URL: https://github.com/TimurRakhmatullin86/mcp-drill
- Language: Python
- Description: Fault injection and contract compliance testing for MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers. Generates compliance scorecards.
- Packages: PyPI
